record.question: It was all profit and no loss.
record.explanation: Answer C: Adjective. The original Revenue Paper I physical page 3 underlines only 'all'. Here 'all' modifies the noun 'profit'; among the paper's traditional part-of-speech labels it is an adjective of quantity. Modern grammar often calls it a determiner, which the printed options do not offer. It is not the noun 'profit'. Independently reviewed best-choice solution, unofficial; no examiner key is asserted.
